description: Fancy pink is a geological accident — trace elements arranged under exactly the right pressure, over exactly the right span of time. The pear shape was chosen deliberately: its axis gives the colour a direction, so the warmth gathers at the tip and opens toward the shoulder as the stone turns. The rose gold setting is tuned to the same colour temperature as the diamond, so metal and stone read as one warmth rather than two. The whole pendant exists for a single purpose — to hold that colour.
